title: Pinned pthread mutex representation and nullable enter/leave dispatch

scope.rationale: These are the active pthread mutex storage/initializer identities and complete concrete plus public-wrapper enter/leave functions used by STATIC_MEM allocator locking.
excluded_responsibilities: Mutex subsystem default-method selection and initialization
No-op mutex implementation and public auto-initialization

external_source_responsibilities: Caller discipline forbidding recursive entry of non-recursive mutexes
dependencies.caller_closure: Concrete pthread enter/leave and nullable configured-method wrappers are assigned. Allocation, initialization, try, and no-op modes remain separate.

inputs: Nullable wrapper mutex or non-null initialized pthread mutex
outputs: Mutex acquired exactly once or released exactly once; null wrapper input is a no-op
contracts.ownership: No allocation or ownership transfer. Mutex storage outlives entry.
contracts.state_and_results: Pinned NREF=0 C storage uses only pthread_mutex_t. Non-recursive reentry is a precondition violation.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Concrete operations call pthread lock/unlock. Wrapper operations dispatch configured callbacks only for non-null input. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Enter blocks until success; leave has undefined behavior on invalid ownership, matching source preconditions.

representation_differences: Pinned C sqlite3_mutex stores only pthread_mutex_t because SQLITE_MUTEX_NREF=0; Zig Mutex additionally tracks owner/depth for native assertions and manual recursive behavior.
The additional Zig tracking does not alter pthread acquisition ordering for STATIC_MEM and other non-recursive mutexes.
C callback wrappers and direct pthread methods remain separate functions; Zig models them with MethodsAdapter and nullable native helpers.

oracle.protocol: Infrastructure C/Zig differential compares recursive/static identities, same-thread and contended entry, null/no-op mode, configured callback dispatch, and mode transitions. Native tests run 40,000 contended recursive updates and allocator alarm unlocked-hook checks.
oracle.normalization: Mutex addresses, pthread object bytes, and Zig-only owner/depth fields are ignored; callback events and synchronization results are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Contention and alarm release/reacquire are tested; exhaustive scheduler/interleaving evidence remains open.
assurance.malformed_input: Null wrappers are tested. Invalid ownership/reentry are source-precondition violations.
assurance.continuation: Repeated enter/leave and post-contention continuation are tested.
assurance.performance: One pthread operation per non-recursive enter/leave plus Zig assertion tracking; overhead review remains open.

integration.production_owner: src/core/mutex.zig Mutex and MethodsAdapter; memory.Manager embeds Mutex kind static_mem
integration.native_call_path: Global allocator status/heap paths call Manager.enter/leave through the shared process STATIC_MEM pointer and Mutex.enter/leave.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: memory.Manager no longer owns an independent raw pthread lock implementation.

independent_review.notes: Must verify NREF profile choice, callback/null paths, pthread ordering, extra tracking overhead, and integration.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/mutex_unix.c:16-395 was reviewed through the complete pthread profile, including representation selection, allocation context, enter/try/leave bodies, and sqlite3DefaultMutex wiring
upstream/sqlite/src/mutex.c:314-354 was reviewed through the complete nullable public enter/leave wrappers and adjacent try behavior
The eight exact source identities and hashes in scope select SQLITE_MUTEX_NREF=0, pthread_mutex_t-only storage, PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, concrete enter/leave, and nullable callback dispatch
src/core/mutex.zig Mutex.enter/leave, nullable enter/leave, and MethodsAdapter.enter/leave are the exact canonical declarations recorded by the AST ledger
callers: pthreadMutexEnter and pthreadMutexLeave have exactly one non-definition source reference each: sqlite3DefaultMutex installs them as xMutexEnter/xMutexLeave at mutex_unix.c:379/381

A complete textual core search finds 199 sqlite3_mutex_enter references and 221 sqlite3_mutex_leave references across 40 source/test/platform files; active responsibilities span allocator/status, connection/VDBE, B-tree, VFS, PCache, virtual-table, backup, prepare, tokenizer, and random owners

Platform-specific mutex_w32, allocator mem2/mem3/mem5, os_win, test*.c, and extension-table references are not active pthread-core callers under the selected profile and receive no integration credit here
Zig Handle and Manager callers route native mutexes to Mutex.enter/leave and configured pointers to MethodsAdapter; lifecycle/allocation owners remain separate dossiers
callees: Selected pthreadMutexEnter performs one pthread_mutex_lock; SQLITE_HOMEGROWN_RECURSIVE_MUTEX, SQLITE_MUTEX_NREF bookkeeping, and SQLITE_DEBUG trace branches are inactive in the pinned production profile
Selected pthreadMutexLeave checks source preconditions and performs one pthread_mutex_unlock; NREF/homegrown/debug branches are inactive
sqlite3_mutex_enter/leave test p for null, assert the configured method exists, and invoke exactly xMutexEnter/xMutexLeave for non-null p
assertions_branches_cleanup: The seven assigned behavior IDs cover wrapper null branches/callback assertions and concrete enter/leave ownership assertions; invalid non-recursive reentry or non-owner leave remains undefined source behavior

SQLITE_MUTEX_NREF=0 removes id/nRef/owner/trace C fields and selects {PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER}; Zig owner/depth fields are an explicit representation difference requiring later trace/performance evidence
No allocation, destruction, result code, callback beyond configured dispatch, or I/O occurs in this unit; blocking and unlock continuation are the only runtime transitions
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/mutex1.test counts static/dynamic mutex entry across single-thread, multithread, serialized, application/VFS, and database mutex paths
upstream/sqlite/test/mutex2.test exercises mutex initialization failure and allocation/deallocation boundaries adjacent to this unit
upstream/sqlite/test/thread001.test through thread005.test and thread1.test/thread2.test exercise shared-handle, independent-handle, contention, and cross-thread continuation
Project mutex.zig recursive/null/configured/contention tests and the infrastructure differential isolate callback dispatch and pthread synchronization; they are not yet durable promotion receipts
